description: Search Storyblocks stock videos, music, sound effects, and images in ChatGPT. Preview results in an interactive media carousel, inspect asset metadata and available formats, find similar content, explore categories and related search terms, and refine searches with catalog counts. Download selected assets when explicitly requested. Requires Storyblocks authentication; downloads depend on account entitlements. Each successful download-link request licenses the asset, records a download, and consumes plan quota, including repeat requests.
